m: यहस् n. (prob. fr. a lost √ यह्, to speed, be quick), water, Naigh. i, 12
यहु mfn. (prob.) ‘restless, swift’, or ‘mighty, strong’, RV. (= महत्, Sāy.)
यहु m. offspring, a child (= अपत्य), Naigh. ii, 2 (सहसो यहुः, RV. viii, 60, 13 = सहसो पुत्रः, Sāy.)
a: यहु — a. Ved. Great. --हुः A child, offspring (पुत्र).

m: यह्वा f. understanding, intelligence (= बुद्धि), L.
यह्वी (ई), f. du. heaven and earth, RV.
pl. the flowing waters (with सप्त, ‘the seven great rivers’), ib. (cf. Naigh. i, 15).

s: puM, (yajatIti । yaja + “SevAyahvajihvAgrIvApvAmIvAH .” uRA॰ 1 । 154 । iti vanpratyayena nipAtitaH .) yakzamAnaH । ityuRAdikozaH ॥ (tri, mahAn । yaTA, fgvede । 3 । 1 । 12 । “udusriyA janitA yo jajAnApAM garBo nftamo yahvo agniH .” “yahvo mahAn .” iti tadBAzye sAyaRaH ॥)
m: यह्व mf(ई)n. restless, swift, active (applied to Agni, Indra and Soma), RV.
continually moving or flowing (applied to the waters), ib. (= महत्, Sāy.)
यह्व m. = यजमान, a sacrificer, Uṇ. i, 134, Sch.
a: यह्व — a. Ved. 1 Great, powerful. --2 Active, restless, continually moving. --ह्वी A river. --f. (dual) An epithet of 1 Heaven and earth. --2 Of night and day. --3 Of morning and evening.
